verdict.rationale: Graphite documents custom rules that let teams define explicit guidelines for Graphite Agent to follow during AI code review, plus comment exclusions to suppress unwanted feedback. Pricing lists "AI Review customizations" as a feature, which covers the core of encoding team review guidelines. missing for 10: explicit evidence of AST/pattern-based rules, support for linking external style guides, detail on the rule format and enforcement behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration that rules are actually enforced.
